title: Lace
description:
S02 E02 — Smoke and Mirrors
Chelsea tells Lacey she's secured the meeting with her father, Gov. Barclay, who is the only one who can pardon Tony, but it will cost her; Lacey and Gideon meet to strategize about her defense.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E03 — Hedge of Protection
With Governor Barclay now at her mercy, things start to turn around for Lacey; Britney meets with Alphonso in jail and offers to represent him; Judge Sears vents at Peter Corbin's lack of results around Lacey.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E04 — Train Up a Child
Agent Diggs meets with Lacey's enemies; he tries to persuade them to work with the FBI and to testify against Lacey; Big D watches the Governor's insincere speech with contempt as he recycles what he said 20 years ago.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E05 — Seize Your Crown
Rev. McCullough welcomes back Tony as the First Lady of Holy Spirit church; during his draft workout for the LA Cheetahs, Frank Marzili advises Savoy not to sign with Daniel McCullough.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E06 — Overdue Diligence
With the newly acquired security footage from Randall's home, Judge Reinhart grants Lacey and Randall a new trial; Captain Warren Sloan congratulates Senator James Barclay on winning his special election.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E07 — A Blessing and a Curse
Tony escorts Britney into the warehouse for the first time; Randall and Daniel hold a press conference to announce their new venture; Sasha and Sloan enjoy their first real date as a couple; Lacey and Mark discuss their marriage issues.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E08 — Through the Valley
Judge Sharon Floyd and Big D broker a truce between Judge Sears and Tony; Randall offers to take Daniel under his wing; Chelsea confronts her father Sen. Barclay about Samantha; Lacey confronts Tony about Tony's new protégé Britney.

description:
